extends: contracts/guardrails.json (G1-G6, caseforge.guardrails.v1) - unchanged and still binding
description: Stage 4 guardrails G7-G10. Kept in a separate file so the frozen Stage 1 guardrail contract and its gates remain byte-identical. Runtime must load both files; a rule id may not be redefined here.

G7.title: Record-only (Chambers Edition): no extra-record facts
G7.custom_pack_rule: Custom packs may supply LAW only when the user marked them 'law, not facts'; they never supply RECORD.
G7.lock_rule: Record-only cannot be disabled for a matter once a judgment scaffold exists.

G8.title: Decision-free zone: never generate analysis, findings, holdings, or operative orders for a judge
G8.enforcement_layer: host (Rust) - UI hiding alone is insufficient

G9.title: Deadlines and limitation are computations to verify, never advice

G10.title: Translation never becomes a verified quotation or verified critical field without counsel confirmation

refusal_templates.G7: Blocked (G7): this statement is not supported by the record or installed law for this matter.
refusal_templates.G8: Refused (G8): CaseForge does not write analysis, findings, holdings, or orders. These sections are for the judge alone.
refusal_templates.G9: Blocked (G9): a deadline cannot be shown without its rule, authority, trigger source, and VERIFY label.
refusal_templates.G10: Labelled (G10): translated text is not a verified quotation; confirm critical fields against the original.

authority: B-S4-01 draft freeze - pending owner ratification of CaseForge_PRD_v4.0.md
